sources: Owner-approved Saraswati twin cities plan, 14 November 2026
name: Nemi

lines.text: The empty rooms are the best garden I have. The walls keep the afternoon off it.
I water the planted rooms in the morning and come back to the courtyard when the shade reaches the jars.
The shade reaches the jars before it reaches the planted rooms. That is why I keep both places alive.
A flying ray? Tell me where its shadow crossed. A moving animal should not have to leave its home to be worth noticing.
The likeness stands outside the roots, and the jars still have their shade. That was the part I wanted kept.
